lines.t: I was dressed in law like armor
Every line a sharpened blade
Letters etched upon my memory
Every debt to judgment paid
I was breathing out the orders
Dragging saints from miles and streets
Certain I was serving heaven
As I trampled at their feet
Then a burning tore the daylight
Threw me shaking to the ground
And the voice I tried to silence
The silence filled my world with living sound
Now the world is black around me
Every lamp inside gone cold
And the man I tried to murder
Is the one who's in control
What have I done?
Whom have I fought?
Did I raise my hand against the very heart of God
Three days without a sky
Just a whisper in the dark
Every law I ever trusted
Cracking open in my heart
Is this mercy, is this judgment
Is this love or is it wrath
Did I kill the risen holy one who stood across my path?
Yet in the ashes of my certainties, a trembling hope draws near
If he speaks my name in darkness, there is more than death to fear
I can hear my own mind turning, like a wheel that's come undone
All my trophies on the council
Every argument I won
I remember faces bleeding
Every plea I brushed aside
Children clinging to their mothers
While I watched their fathers die
If the one I called a blasphemer
Is enthroned above the stars
And my zeal has been a sword that carved his image into scars
Every psalm I used for power, every law I used to kill
Now it turns like rolling thunder, have I fought his very will?
What have I done? How can I stand?
If the pierced one that I hunted
Holds my life within his hand
Three days without a sky
Just a whisper in the dark
Every law I ever trusted
Cracking open in my heart
Is this mercy? Is this judgment?
Is this love or is it wrath?
Did I kill the risen Holy One who stood across my path?
Yet in the ashes of my certainties, a trembling hope draws near
If He blinds me with His presence, maybe He has kept me here
There is terror in this silence, where I feel my idols break
Where the God I thought I honored shows me what it means to shake
But there's promise in this prison, in this veil across my eyes
For the one who could have crushed me, chose to answer all my lies
If he meant to throw me under, would he speak to me at all?
Would he leave me with his name still burning hot inside my skull?
I am empty as a vessel, lying shattered on the floor
If he fills me with his spirit, I will spill him evermore
Then a stranger touched my shoulder, called me brother in that room
As I trembled laid upon me
And the night broke like a tomb
Scales of darkness fell like embers
And the light cut through the haze
And the face I once despised
Was shining in that servant's gaze
I could feel the past unmaking
As another future rose
Where the blood upon my conscience met the blood that cleanses souls
He had every right to end me, yet he chose to make me new
From a hunter of his people to a witness he would use
Three days without a sky, now the horizon splits with fire
Every breath a gift of mercy From the King whom I conspired
I was enemy and weapon I was storm upon His bride
But He broke my sword and scepter Drew me wounded to His side
Fear and dread became a doorway Where His promise pulled me through
If he can't pardon one like Saul, what can his love undo?
I went in blind and guilty, I rose obscene and known
Struck down by the man I murdered, raised to preach his mercy shown
